title: Inspect and extend: Repositories and issues as typed records
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/github.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve repository/issue shapes, response mapping, sample data, and sort fields.
problem: An API response is not yet a screen-ready object. Learn the normalized types and mapper functions, then compare sample rows with fields expected from GitHub. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/github.ts` and the related project files: src/github.ts; src/data.ts.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to repository/issue shapes, response mapping, sample data, and sort fields.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Seed data is a fallback/demo and should not be confused with live account data.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: An API response is not yet a screen-ready object. Learn the normalized types and mapper functions, then compare sample rows with fields expected from GitHub.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/github.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
